v19-20.candidate: The old man said, “Peace be to you. Still, let all your need fall on me; but do not lodge in the square.”

v19-22.candidate: While their hearts were glad, behold, the men of the city, sons of lawless men, surrounded the house and struck the door. They said to the old man, the master of the house, “Bring out the man who entered your house, that we may know him.”

v19-28.candidate: He said to her, “Get up, and let us go.” She did not answer him, but she had died. He lifted her onto the pack animal, and the man arose and went to his place.
